turns.text: Thanks for coming. A stain appeared above our reception desk after last night's rain. We're opening another office next month, so a new roof would be hard to afford.
turns.zh: 謝謝你趕來。昨晚下雨後，我們接待桌上方出現了污漬。下個月還要開另一處辦公室，換新屋頂恐怕負擔不起。

turns.text: I'll check the roof first. A clog in a roof gutter can make water collect even when the roof is sound.
turns.zh: 我先檢查屋頂。就算屋頂本身完好，屋頂的排水槽一旦堵塞，也可能積水。

turns.text: The building manager did see leaves in the gutters. Can you get upstairs while our clients arrive?
turns.zh: 大樓管理員的確看到排水槽裡有落葉。客戶陸續抵達的時候，你可以上樓嗎？

turns.text: I'll take the service stairs, away from the lobby. If we clear the blockage, you may not need a new roof.
turns.zh: 我會走不經過大廳的服務樓梯。如果把堵塞清掉，你可能就不用換屋頂。

turns.text: That's a relief. Please take photos of anything you find, so I can show the manager why the work was needed.
turns.zh: 那我就放心了。你發現什麼都請拍照，我好向管理員說明為什麼有必要施工。

turns.text: We need a room for a drawing workshop. There will be twenty-four people, so we need tables. Theater seating will not work.
turns.zh: 我們需要一間辦繪圖工作坊的教室。會有二十四人，所以需要桌子。劇院式座位不適合。

turns.text: Here are the room listings. The middle column shows how many people fit with tables.
turns.zh: 這是各間教室的出租資訊。中間欄顯示擺放桌子時可容納的人數。

turns.text: We can spend up to two hundred dollars. A larger room would cost too much.
turns.zh: 我們最多可以花兩百美元。更大的教室會太貴。

turns.text: Then I recommend the room for thirty people. A projector comes with every room.
turns.zh: 那我推薦可容納三十人的那間教室。每間都附投影機。

turns.text: Please book it for Monday. We need to get in half an hour early to set out drawing supplies.
turns.zh: 請預訂星期一。我們需要提早半小時入場，擺放繪圖用品。

turns.text: Of course. I'll put eight thirty as your arrival time on the confirmation.
turns.zh: 沒問題，我會在確認函上註明你們八點半抵達。
